items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Tricky used to tell me all the time, you know, -- Tricky had a real high voice -- he said, 'Gee whiz, when are you going to give me a break?

ctx.x: And that's when I first got a chance to work with Sandy, and, really, you know what Sandy -- Tricky used to tell me all the time, you know, -- Tricky had a real high voice -- he said, 'Gee whiz, when are you going to give me a break? When are you going to sit in my chair, man? You
sit over there in Tizol's chair all the time." I told him, I said, "It'll never happen. I'll never try to play -- I'll never be able to grab that plunger. No, no." And where did I wind up?
